summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing plans to evaluate strategic alternatives for its 100%-owned tungsten assets, including the Northern Dancer Tungsten-Molybdenum Project in Canada and the Currais Novos Tungsten Project in Brazil. Alternatives may include partnerships, joint ventures, asset-level financing, minority investments, sale, spin-out, or offtake structures. No financial advisor has been engaged yet. The board has not made a recommendation at this stage. The process is exploratory, triggered by unsolicited expressions of interest, with no specific terms, price, or timeline disclosed. Watch for engagement of an advisor and potential transaction announcements.
